feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: OpenClaw 2026.10.6 requires patched Node releases
entry.summary: OpenClaw 2026.10.6 requires Node 24.22.1+ or 26.12.1+, following the October 2026 Node.js security release. `openclaw update` refuses to install on older Node versions and prints recovery guidance instead.

entry.title: Langflow 1.12.7 ships a batch of security fixes
entry.summary: Langflow 1.12.7 labels most of its 15 fixes as security fixes, including enforcing admin policy on public component builds and rejecting process and code loader capabilities. 1.12.8 followed on October 22, 2026 with two bug fixes.

entry.title: Haystack 3.4.1 drops trust in compromised emSign CAs
entry.summary: Haystack 3.4.1 requires certifi 2026.10.19 or later (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2), because earlier certifi versions trust eMudhra/emSign certificate authorities whose private keys were compromised. Users who pin certifi should raise the pin.

entry.title: Phoenix 20.24.0 tightens dependency security
entry.summary: Arize Phoenix 20.24.0 requires certifi 2026.10.18 to distrust the compromised emSign root, requires Node releases from the October 2026 security release, and excludes a litellm release its changelog describes as compromised.

entry.title: Strands Agents 1.62.0 makes middleware public
entry.summary: Strands Agents Python 1.62.0 makes its middleware system public, applies invocation limits and usage tracking across a whole agent tree, adds swarm tooling and an experimental OpenAI Live provider.

entry.title: Atomic Agents 2.15.0 emits OpenTelemetry GenAI spans
entry.summary: Atomic Agents 2.15.0 tracing emits OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention spans readable by any OTLP backend, depends only on opentelemetry-api, and can hide inputs and outputs. Phoenix and OpenInference become optional.

entry.title: ServiceNow control tower now governs its Arc agent
entry.summary: ServiceNow's control tower, called the Super Intelligence Control Tower in the release, now sets policy for Arc, a personal enterprise agent made GA on October 21, 2026. AI Passport enforcement, including on NVIDIA OpenShell and BlueField, comes later.

source.title: ServiceNow delivers industry-first personal enterprise agent and policy enforcement with NVIDIA

entry.title: Org policies can mandate Model Armor filters
entry.summary: Custom organization policies, now generally available, can require that all new or updated Model Armor templates enforce mandatory filters, such as responsible AI and prompt-injection and jailbreak detection.

entry.title: OpenAI GPT-6 models enter Google Cloud Model Garden
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are rolling out in private preview to select enterprise customers in Google Cloud's Model Garden. Gemini for business and Antigravity support are listed as coming soon.

source.title: Google Cloud expands model choice and flexibility, bringing OpenAI models to customers

entry.title: Unity Gateway screens MCP tool calls for jailbreaks
entry.summary: Unity Gateway can now screen MCP tool calls and their results for jailbreak and prompt-injection attempts in beta, with the Jailbreak guardrail applied to input, output or both.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI provider packages deprecated for createAI
entry.summary: Cloudflare feature-froze and deprecated workers-ai-provider and ai-gateway-provider. The Agents SDK createAI replaces them, covering Workers AI, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes and vendor models.

entry.title: Antigravity Enterprise Gateway is generally available
entry.summary: Organizations can route Antigravity app, CLI and IDE extension model requests through a central gateway for inspection, policy enforcement and gateway API-key authentication. These requests use pay-as-you-go billing, not seat quotas.

entry.title: Gemini for government services enters preview
entry.summary: Google announced Gemini for government services in preview, built on the Gemini agent and deployable inside the Assured Workloads FedRAMP High data boundary with VPC Service Controls and CMEK. No product-wide authorization status is stated.

entry.title: NemoClaw v0.0.137 defaults to Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
entry.summary: NemoClaw v0.0.137 makes Nemotron 3.5 Super VL the default hosted model for new OpenClaw and Hermes onboarding and improves uninstall recovery, managed image security and policy recovery.

entry.title: Pydantic AI 2.58.0 fixes MCP credential leak in traces
entry.summary: Pydantic AI 2.58.0 fixes GHSA-xv4x-g8mx-ch56 (medium): provider-native MCP configuration could expose server URLs, authorization tokens and custom headers in OpenTelemetry traces, even with include_content=False. Rotate exposed credentials.

entry.title: Foundry browser automation tool is generally available
entry.summary: Microsoft Foundry's browser automation tool is GA: agents get a managed Playwright Workspaces browser that can reach private sites over an Azure virtual network, with an MCP-compatible endpoint, Live View, approval gates and allow lists.

source.title: Browser automation tool in Microsoft Foundry is now GA

entry.title: Copilot deprecates six models
entry.summary: GitHub deprecated Gemini 3.7 Flash, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4.5 across Copilot on October 19, 2026. Suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and Grok 4.7.

source.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on October 19, 2026

entry.title: Copilot model policy API is generally available
entry.summary: REST endpoints to read and set Copilot model policies are GA at enterprise, enterprise-team, agent-app and organization level. Enterprise policy can delegate model control to organizations or to teams and apps.

source.title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams

entry.title: Guardrails grounding checks add a Standard tier
entry.summary: Bedrock Guardrails contextual grounding checks now support the Standard tier, which handles reasoning and conversational responses with more consistent scores and more languages. It needs cross-Region inference; Classic stays the default.

source.title: Use contextual grounding check to filter hallucinations in responses

entry.title: Kiro adds Memory and CLI workspace trust
entry.summary: Kiro IDE 1.4.0 (October 19, 2026) adds Memory across chat sessions, and IDE 1.4.10 (October 20) turns it off by default. Kiro CLI 2.33.0 (October 20) asks users to trust a folder before loading its hooks, agents and MCP servers.

entry.title: AutoGen is archived and no longer maintained
entry.summary: Microsoft updated the AutoGen README to state the project is archived and no longer maintained, with no bug or security fixes, and points users to Microsoft Agent Framework. The last release was python-v0.7.5 on September 30, 2025.

source.title: docs: clarify AutoGen is archived and no longer maintained (#8366)

entry.title: CrewAI Agent Control Plane is generally available
entry.summary: CrewAI's Agent Control Plane is GA on CrewAI AMP, giving fleet visibility and 13 built-in runtime policies (such as PII masking, allowed models and tools, and cost limits) that can be toggled across deployments, plus custom policies.

source.title: How to govern enterprise agents at runtime with the CrewAI Agent Control Plane

entry.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.24.0 changes saved-run format
entry.summary: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.24.0 adds run-wide tool error formatting and MCP annotations on converted tools. RunState snapshots move to schema 1.21, which older SDKs cannot read; finish older saved runs on their original SDK.

entry.title: Copilot to retire Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra
entry.summary: GitHub will deprecate Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra across Copilot on November 16, 2026, pointing to Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol or GPT-6 Luna.

source.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-November

entry.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts is GA
entry.summary: Assigning a code scanning alert to Copilot now produces a validated fix as a draft pull request. It needs GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security on Enterprise Cloud, uses AI Credits and Actions minutes, and must be enabled by admin policy.

source.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability

entry.title: Kimi K3 added to Kiro (experimental)
entry.summary: Kimi K3 is available in Kiro with experimental support for Pro, Pro+, Pro Max and Power customers in the US geography, at a 2.4x credit multiplier.

entry.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 GA in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Admins can make Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 available in the Gemini Enterprise app (global, us and eu locations) by enabling third-party models; usage is billed pay-as-you-go.

entry.title: Unity Gateway consumer access is GA
entry.summary: Users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable a preview before querying shared model services through Unity Gateway. Admins can still set budgets and rate limits.

entry.title: Genie Code SQL converter is generally available
entry.summary: The agentic code converter powered by Genie Code is GA for SQL, converting T-SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata dialects to Databricks SQL and validating the output.

entry.title: Braintrust evals can run through provider batch APIs
entry.summary: Braintrust eval tasks and scorers can run through OpenAI and Anthropic batch APIs, which those providers price 50% below standard, with results tracked in one experiment. Needs TS SDK 3.37.0+ or Python SDK 0.45.0+.

source.title: Run evals 50% cheaper with workflow evals

entry.title: Descope Agentic Identity Hub 3.0 adds governance suite
entry.summary: Agentic Identity Hub 3.0 adds an Agentic Governance Suite (Enterprise tier), policy engine v2 with explicit deny policies, Agent SSO via Cross-App Access (ID-JAG), and SPIFFE, private_key_jwt and mTLS client authentication.

entry.title: Claude Sonnet 4 reaches end of life in Kiro
entry.summary: Claude Sonnet 4 reached end of life in Kiro on October 14, 2026; users relying on it need to switch models. Claude Sonnet 5.5 is the latest Sonnet in Kiro.

entry.title: GPT-5.5 retired in Codex for ChatGPT sign-in
entry.summary: GPT-5.5 is no longer available in Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT; API-key sessions are unaffected. OpenAI points users to gpt-6.1-sol and says to update saved configs, agents and scheduled tasks.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon is generally available in Copilot
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is GA for Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise with a gradual rollout. Business and Enterprise admins control it through model policy; billing is usage-based at provider list pricing.

entry.title: Copilot clients can fail closed on stale policy
entry.summary: Enterprise admins can set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh so Copilot CLI, VS Code and the Copilot app fail closed when they cannot confirm current policy. The sandbox key now enforces a minimum client version.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon GA in Gemini Enterprise
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is GA in the Gemini Enterprise web app, mobile app and AI developer tools, and in Workflow Builder from October 14, 2026. Gemini 3.8 Flash also became GA in the UK region on October 14.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon GA on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
entry.summary: Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 4 Argon Cyber Permissive are GA on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with 1,048,576-token input and output limits. Cyber Permissive is limited to an allowlist program.

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon added to Unity Gateway
entry.summary: Google Gemini 4 Argon is available on Databricks Unity Gateway through Foundation Model APIs.

entry.title: LangSmith AI Search for agent traces in public beta
entry.summary: LangSmith adds natural-language search over agent traces (for example user frustration or PII leaks) in public beta on LangSmith Cloud in GCP US, EU and APAC; org admins enable it in settings.

source.title: Search agent traces by behavior with AI Search in LangSmith

entry.title: Paperclip lets Claude Code, Codex and MCP clients join
entry.summary: Paperclip v2026.1012.0 adds an experimental, off-by-default option for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other MCP clients to connect as signed-in users via OAuth or device-code consent, with opt-out write access.

entry.title: Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent become legacy
entry.summary: Databricks made Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent legacy, recommending the Agent Bricks CLI for code-based agents and Genie Agents for no-code agents.

entry.title: Kong Gateway 3.16.0.1 adds A2A v1.0 in AI Gateway
entry.summary: Kong Gateway 3.16.0.1 adds the A2A v1.0 wire format to ai-a2a-proxy alongside v0.3, prompt cache-control mappings for OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock in ai-proxy-advanced, and several routing and telemetry fixes.

entry.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder agent models
entry.summary: Meta released Muse Wonder, available via the Meta Model API and Muse Code, and Muse Wonder Full for Muse Code subscribers. Muse Wonder will soon power the Muse app, starting with subscribers.

source.title: Introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full

entry.title: Gemini Code Assist — deprecation
entry.summary: Google stopped selling new Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise subscriptions on October 9, 2026. Existing subscriptions auto-renew through 2026, auto-renewal ends in 2027, and Google points customers to Antigravity.

source.title: Gemini for Google Cloud release notes

entry.title: NanoClaw — release
entry.summary: NanoClaw v2026.10.0 moved to calendar versioning with stable, beta and edge update channels. OneCLI installs must upgrade the gateway to 1.42.0 to close a credential-injection bypass, and a WhatsApp message-spoofing flaw was patched.

entry.title: Pydantic AI — release
entry.summary: Pydantic AI 2.55.0 requires Python 3.11+ in every package, adds a Conversation object and Postgres step and media stores, and supports Claude Haiku 5.5.

entry.title: n8n — release
entry.summary: n8n 2.42.6 blocks creating or updating workflows that use deprecated nodes and adds Gemini image models.

entry.title: Langfuse — release
entry.summary: Langfuse 4.55 added FIPS-mode Docker images, a Google Cloud Storage export target and batch score ingestion; 4.56.0 adds spend alerts and moves score reads to read replicas.

entry.title: Arize Phoenix — feature
entry.summary: Arize Phoenix 20.20.0 adds a Docker Sandboxes provider and MCP GraphQL tools.

entry.title: Google Model Armor — feature
entry.summary: Model Armor improved prompt-injection and jailbreak protection for Workspace data such as emails, docs and files, on US and EU multi-region endpoints with filter version v3 or later.

entry.title: CrewAI — release
entry.summary: CrewAI 1.15.27 adds DeepInfra as an OpenAI-compatible provider and stops sending stop sequences to GPT-6, GPT-5.6 and gpt-oss models.

entry.title: Opik — release
entry.summary: Opik 2.2.96 is the latest release; the 2.2.92 line added a free-form SQL post-run check and a native Ollama integration.

entry.title: OpenAI Codex — feature
entry.summary: Codex added GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast mode for Pro and eligible Enterprise and Edu plans. It is off by default for Enterprise and supports US and EEA/Switzerland inference residency.

entry.title: ChatGPT Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast mode is available for eligible ChatGPT Enterprise workspaces. It is off by default and workspace owners must enable it.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — model-addition
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise admins can enable Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 for Antigravity tools. They are off by default and billed as consumption with overages enabled.

entry.title: Hermes Agent — release
entry.summary: Hermes Agent 0.21.6 is the first release from the new stable pipeline and fixes dashboard auth, automatic execution of repo git filters, and an email allowlist bypass.

entry.title: Microsoft Agent Framework — release
entry.summary: Agent Framework python-1.21.0 adds Purview policy evaluation for streamed responses and an alpha Oracle vector store. python-1.20.0 added hosting of native workflows over Foundry, with breaking changes to Foundry hosting settings.

entry.title: Strands Agents — release
entry.summary: Strands Agents Python 1.59.0 and TypeScript 1.20.0 add Agent.shutdown(), agent.cancel() and a vended subagent tool, and graduate TypeScript bidirectional streaming.

entry.title: OpenClaw — release
entry.summary: OpenClaw stable 2026.9.9 shipped with 185 commits; a 2026.10.1 beta hotfix for update recovery and plugin loading followed the same day.

entry.title: LiteLLM — release
entry.summary: LiteLLM 1.104.2 is the latest stable release and backports the /v1/systemone and OpenAI-format /v1/decisions endpoints.

entry.title: Temporal — release
entry.summary: Temporal 1.32.1 patches Standalone Activity task routing, task-queue user data and fair task garbage collection.

entry.title: Claude Agent SDK — release
entry.summary: Claude Agent SDK 0.2.165 bundles Claude Code CLI 2.1.294.

entry.title: Nous Research raises $90M Series B
entry.summary: Nous Research, maker of Hermes Agent, raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation led by Robot Ventures, and plans Hermes for Businesses, a version of the agent for companies.

source.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users

entry.title: MLflow — release
entry.summary: MLflow 3.17.0 adds typed judge decisions, fine-grained permissions for shared resources and faster SQL trace analytics. It requires a coordinated database upgrade.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is generally available in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — feature
entry.summary: Local sandboxing is generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code Agent Host sessions at no extra cost, with enterprise policies developers cannot weaken.

source.title: Local sandboxing for GitHub Copilot now generally available

entry.title: Claude Code — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Code 2.1.293 made Claude Haiku 5.5 (1M context) the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API.

entry.title: Claude Enterprise — model-addition
entry.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, available on all Claude plans including Enterprise.

entry.title: Databricks Unity Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Unity Gateway external service policies (Beta) can send request and response content to a third-party guardrail vendor and block denied calls.

entry.title: Mastra — release
entry.summary: Mastra core 1.75.0 adds a span query API, token and cost analytics, and @mastra/connect 1.0 with Microsoft Teams. Breaking: integrations is renamed providers.

entry.title: Google Antigravity — feature
entry.summary: Antigravity 2.21.1 renamed Scheduled Tasks to Automations and added search across conversations.

entry.title: SailPoint Agent Identity Security — feature
entry.summary: At Navigate 2026 SailPoint announced autonomous identity security agents, AI identity security posture management, an agent kill switch, runtime authorization, shadow-AI discovery and just-in-time provisioning for agents.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise added admin controls for Antigravity: Boost is generally available and Teamwork is in Preview.

entry.title: Databricks Genie Code — release
entry.summary: Genie Code CLI entered Beta as a terminal coding agent for data and AI work, with model access governed through Unity Gateway.

entry.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot — feature
entry.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot added Copilot Search with embedded chat, a switch-model option, custom skills in PowerPoint and Cowork adoption metrics in Viva Insights.

entry.title: LangFlow — release
entry.summary: LangFlow 1.12.5 fixes MCP session leaks and timeouts, restricts built-in code execution to administrators and upgrades vulnerable dependencies.

entry.title: Semantic Kernel — release
entry.summary: Semantic Kernel python-1.45.0 removes an unsupported auth mode from the Copilot Studio agent (breaking) and hardens request validation; dotnet-1.81.0 shipped the same day.

entry.title: LangGraph — release
entry.summary: LangGraph 1.2.14 fixes update_state and checkpoint branching issues.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor added remote control of local agents from its iOS app. It is on by default except in Enterprise orgs, where admins must enable it.

entry.title: Paperclip — release
entry.summary: Paperclip v2026.1005.0 adds Grok Build on the native runner, persistent agent files, GitHub skill sync and two-way Slack. Breaking: @-mentioning an agent no longer starts a run.

entry.title: Databricks Lakeflow Jobs — feature
entry.summary: Lakeflow Jobs can now use up to five triggers per job (Beta), mixing trigger types and pausing each one separately.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — deprecation
entry.summary: GitHub deprecated Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code and Claude Opus 4.7 across Copilot; suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash, Kimi K3 and Claude Opus 5.5.

source.title: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated

entry.title: Kiro — model-addition
entry.summary: Kiro added experimental Claude Sonnet 5.5 support with a 1M-token context window across the IDE, CLI and Web.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — feature
entry.summary: Gemini Enterprise federated query mode (Preview) queries AlloyDB, BigQuery, Cloud SQL and Spanner data in place through MCP using each user’s credentials.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Cloudflare launched a Web Search API in beta that runs through AI Gateway, with Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup as providers.

entry.title: agentgateway — release
entry.summary: agentgateway 1.6.0 adds more resilient LLM routing, built-in cost tracking and enables the AgentgatewayModel API by default.

entry.title: Google Agent Builder + ADK — release
entry.summary: ADK for Python 2.11.0 adds graceful cancellation, approval pauses for tool nodes in workflows, a SQLite memory service and opt-in MCP SDK 2.x.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents SDK — release
entry.summary: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.x adds configurable MCP listing page limits and opt-in Docker removal protection for sandboxes.

entry.title: Haystack — release
entry.summary: Haystack 3.3.0 makes SentenceWindowRetriever query the document store once per call; BM25 retrieval now returns only documents matching a query term.

entry.title: Gemini Enterprise — deprecation
entry.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro will be removed from the Gemini Enterprise app in the Canada and Japan in-country regions on October 20, 2026; it stays in global, US and EU.

entry.title: Pydantic AI — release
entry.summary: Pydantic AI 2.53.0 fixed high-severity advisory GHSA-6fqq-452j-qhrp, where a streamed request through ConcurrencyLimitedModel could keep its concurrency slot and block other requests sharing the limiter. Pydantic AI v1 is not affected.

entry.title: Kiro — feature
entry.summary: Kiro introduced multi-agent Workflows across the CLI, IDE and Web cloud sessions.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway added Machine Payments (beta), letting clients pay for eligible requests over x402 from a stablecoin wallet.

entry.title: n8n — release
entry.summary: n8n 2.41.4 added an n8n Assistant onboarding thread for new Cloud sign-ups and usage-based credit top-ups, alongside execution and queue-handling fixes.

entry.title: LangFlow — release
entry.summary: Langflow 1.12.4 shipped a security-hardening patch covering authentication, DNS validation, privilege enforcement, and sanitisation fixes.

entry.title: Mastra — release
entry.summary: Mastra core 1.72.0 added live channel resolvers for connecting channels without redeploying, persisted ownership leases for multi-worker background tasks, and a Microsoft Teams channel.

entry.title: Manus — feature
entry.summary: Manus 2.0 added the Cascade harness, Cloud Computer for always-on projects, event-triggered Automations, Manus Studio, Computer Use and the Cue personal-agent app in early access.

entry.title: Grok Bot — feature
entry.summary: xAI opened Team Bots, shared always-on bots for Grok Teams and Enterprise plans, as a public beta.

entry.title: CrewAI — release
entry.summary: CrewAI 1.15.23 added native Gemini 3.8 Flash support, evaluation of the last traced run through AMP, and richer task spans in tracing.

entry.title: Microsoft Autopilot — rename
entry.summary: Microsoft renamed its always-on agent Microsoft Scout to Autopilot in the new Copilot, with usage-based billing and a private preview expanding to more Frontier customers at the end of September.

source.title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot · Official Microsoft Blog

entry.title: Haystack — release
entry.summary: Haystack 3.2.0 added an experimental SummarizationCompactor and TokenBudgetHook for agents, plus fluent Pipeline.add_components and connect_many helpers.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — model-addition
entry.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 became selectable in GitHub Copilot for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans across IDEs, GitHub.com, Copilot CLI, and the coding agent.

source.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot · GitHub Changelog

entry.title: LlamaIndex — release
entry.summary: LlamaIndex 0.14.25 resolved a large batch of security alerts and added Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 support in the Anthropic and Bedrock Converse integrations.

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — feature
entry.summary: AWS released the new AgentCore Runtime (V2) with consumption-based memory billing and about 2-second P75 cold starts, in five regions.

source.title: The new AgentCore Runtime is now available in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore · AWS What’s New

entry.title: Microsoft Agent Framework — release
entry.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework Python 1.19.0 added generic vector-store provider protocols with MongoDB and Azure DocumentDB connectors, with breaking changes to cookie persistence and MCP skill archives.

entry.title: MLflow — release
entry.summary: MLflow 3.16.1 removed the default basic-auth admin password (a security fix for self-hosted servers) and added scorer timeouts.

entry.title: NeMo Guardrails — release
entry.summary: NeMo Guardrails 0.24.1 fixed benchmark concurrency measurement, Nemotron 3.5 response parsing, server overload handling, and combined-config loading.

entry.title: Temporal — release
entry.summary: Temporal Server 1.32.0 made Standalone Activities generally available and added Serverless Workers support for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime.

entry.title: Mastra — release
entry.summary: Mastra core 1.66.0 added deploy-scoped worker manifests, richer trace and feedback queries, observability-signal deletion, observational-memory transform hooks, and a first-chunk streaming timeout.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot — feature
entry.summary: GitHub Copilot added Jira-to-implementation context in the Copilot app, experimental adaptive model routing in Copilot CLI, recurring agent automations in VS Code, and centrally managed JetBrains sandbox policies.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor launched Projects in beta for long-lived bodies of work, with a coordinator that delegates to parallel cloud and local agents, shared project context, and scheduled or event-driven subscriptions.

entry.title: Microsoft Agent Framework — release
entry.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework Python 1.18.0 added shared vector-store abstractions and Azure AI Search, Redis, Qdrant, and pgvector connectors, plus bounded tool-loop duration and several credential, file, and checkpoint hardening changes.

entry.title: CrewAI — release
entry.summary: CrewAI 1.15.21 added telemetry for checkpoint runtime and CLI usage and fixed gateway-error reporting, UTF-8 JSON checkpoints, streaming tool-call arguments, and JSON Schema type-array handling.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents SDK — release
entry.summary: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.2 added current image-generation tool options and hardened UnixLocal sandbox file handling against symlink races, following the broader MCP guardrail and isolation work in 0.22.1.

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents — feature
entry.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory added direct long-term-memory ingestion for conversational or JSON payloads without first persisting a short-term memory event.

source.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports direct ingestion to long-term memory

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents — feature
entry.summary: Amazon Bedrock made OpenAI GPT-6 Astra generally available with up to a 1 million-token input context window and support for advanced computer and browser use in agent workflows.

source.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock

entry.title: Muse — release
entry.summary: Meta launched Muse in the US, a personal AI agent that runs tasks in its own secure VM and is reachable in the Muse app and WhatsApp.

entry.title: agentgateway — release
entry.summary: agentgateway 1.5.0 added API-key-scoped LLM budgets, native Gemini APIs, and guardrails on tool calls, with breaking JWT and token-count changes.

entry.title: Cursor — feature
entry.summary: Cursor now states that it holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certifications, alongside its SOC 2 Type II attestation and AIUC-1 certification.

source.title: Certifications and third-party assessments · Cursor Security

entry.title: Okta for AI Agents — feature
entry.summary: Okta made Agent SSO generally available, built on the Cross App Access standard and included in core Okta SSO.

source.title: Okta brings first-class identity to AI agents with Agent SSO · Okta

entry.title: Microsoft Agent Framework — release
entry.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework Python 1.15.0 added optional A2UI support for agent-generated interfaces, first-class middleware failure signaling, and broader runtime and integration updates.

entry.title: CrewAI — release
entry.summary: CrewAI 1.15.17 expanded declarative conversational flows, improved oversized-message chunking, and fixed MCP HTTP and SSE server naming plus failed-attempt scope cleanup.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents SDK — release
entry.summary: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 hardened runtime state and guardrail handling, including redaction of rejected terminal tool output, and tightened explicit OpenAI client configuration rules.

entry.title: Mastra — release
entry.summary: Mastra core 1.60.0 added durable execution for Agents API-created agents without redeployment and introduced a Cloudflare Sandbox provider for remote workspaces.

entry.title: Paperclip — release
entry.summary: Paperclip v2026.817.0 delivered its first stable release through the new canary-to-stable channels, adding a first-class decisions workflow, full-fidelity company import/export, and managed CLI installation.

entry.title: OpenAI Agents SDK — release
entry.summary: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.21.0 added provider-neutral deterministic testing utilities, OpenAI Python 3 compatibility, and hardened interruption snapshots, approvals, MCP lifecycle isolation, and sensitive-error redaction.

entry.title: Guardrails AI — deprecation
entry.summary: Guardrails AI 0.11.0 deprecated its Hub CLI and private validator registry as the project moved validator distribution to public PyPI.

entry.title: Flowise — deprecation
